definition: a sheltered place on the coast for boats
description: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

taps.phrase: to lean on a rusty bollard
